title: CaseGenerationRequest
description: Body of POST /api/cases; NATS cases.request.generate (jobId required there).

jobId.description: Client-chosen job id (e.g. a UUID). Reusing the id of a running or recently finished job is rejected.

icd.description: ICD-11 stem code. With ICD configured ('ICD' in /api/features) it alone identifies the diagnosis and wins over 'diagnosis'; without, it rides along unchecked.

diagnosis.description: Diagnosis name, in the request language. Required without ICD; with ICD it must match an ICD-11 title or synonym exactly.

userInstructions.description: Additional context for case generation. Absorbed into the plan: ignored when 'plan' is set.

generationFlags.description: Generation flags to specify case fields to generate

language.description: Language to generate the case in. One of: en, de.

difficulty.description: How unclear the diagnosis should be to a student working through the case. 'easy' features a clean, classic subset of symptoms with definitive procedure results; 'medium' adds distractor symptoms from other diseases and minor/borderline changes in procedure results; 'hard' presents an atypical case with omitted hallmark symptoms and ambiguous procedure results. Defaults to 'medium'.

mode.description: 'normal' generates the case end to end and hands over its (English) plan on the way. 'plan' stops once the plan exists and returns it in the request language; send the same request back with `plan` to generate the case from it.

plan.description: A plan from an earlier call with this request, possibly edited: planning is skipped and the case is generated from it. In plan mode it is in the request language, in normal mode English — exactly as it was handed out. Fixed segments must be unchanged.

llmConfig.description: Optional per-request model selection for the LLM used in case generation. Applies to all internal roles (generator/judge/translator) uniformly — per-role overrides are not supported in the request body.
